# University of California Office of the President

> > Central administrative headquarters for the University of California system, providing systemwide leadership, policy guidance, and academic personnel management across all UC campuses.

UCOP oversees academic affairs, personnel policies, compliance, and external relations for the 10-campus UC system. The office houses the Provost's office led by Katherine S. Newman and manages the Academic Personnel Manual (APM), which governs faculty appointments, leave policies, affirmative action, and conflict of commitment across all University of California campuses including UCLA.

## Key Topics

- Academic Personnel Manual (APM)
- University of California system administration
- Katherine S. Newman (Provost)
- Academic personnel policy and faculty governance
- Affirmative action and Proposition 209
- Conflict of commitment and ethics policies
- Leave policies and family medical accommodation
- Faculty appointments and recruitment
- Systemwide Office of Civil Rights
- Ethics, Compliance & Audit Services
- UC academic leadership and governance
- Higher education policy in California
- APM policy issuances and revisions

- [Issuance of Revised APM - 240, 246, 700, 711, 715, 730, 759, 760 | UCOP](https://www.ucop.edu/academic-personnel-programs/academic-personnel-policy/policy-issuances-and-guidelines/apm-240-246-700-711-715-730-759-760-issuance.html): APM updates for leave policies, family medical leave, accommodation
- [Issuance of Revised APM - 500 and Rescission of APM - 501 | UCOP](https://www.ucop.edu/academic-personnel-programs/academic-personnel-policy/policy-issuances-and-guidelines/apm-500.html): APM-500 recruitment policy revision and APM-501 rescission notice
